description: This Scala source file defines a test suite for evaluating the fault tolerance of the Spark standalone scheduler, mainly focusing on the Master component. It uses Docker to simulate a distributed cluster environment and includes methods for managing Docker containers, cluster state assertions, and various fault scenarios.

classes.name: TestMasterInfo
classes.description: Represents a Spark master node in the test environment, capable of reading its state and killing its Docker container.

classes.name: TestWorkerInfo
classes.description: Represents a Spark worker node in the test environment, capable of killing its Docker container.

methods.name: startMaster
methods.description: Starts a Docker container running a Spark master for testing.

methods.name: startWorker
methods.description: Starts a Docker container running a Spark worker for testing.

methods.name: startNode
methods.description: Executes the Docker run command to start a container and captures its IP and ID.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the Docker container associated with a master or worker.

methods.name: getLastProcessId
methods.description: Retrieves the Docker container ID of the last started container.
